launch: Normal Debug containing app and embedded system share extension. App and extension share their configured simulator inbox App Group. The app launches without the isolated UI-test workspace flag.

sender.description: Disposable UIKit sender app presenting the native UIActivityViewController with two fictional plain-text lists.

import.checks: Cancel in the system share extension leaves the inbox empty. Save for review stages one entry at ledger revision 2. The duplicate requires a decision, and cancelling the app review leaves the entry available. Confirming the merge commits revision 3. The original two-wrap quantity and three pears survive relaunch.

undo.checks: Undo creates revision 4. After relaunch the two original wraps remain and the imported pears are gone. The same payload-free consumed receipt remains in the inbox database.

earlierAttempts.finding: iOS 27 rejected the disposable sender because its first build used the pre-scene application lifecycle.
The native sheet exposed the extension as an activity cell and the test initially queried it as a button.
Extension Cancel completed with zero inbox entries. XCTest could not tap the covered sender button after dismissal.
Waiting for the sender button to become hittable timed out. The successful run used a fresh sender launch for the Save scenario.
Execution stopped during the starting list setup when the turn was interrupted.

scope: System extension activation, app-group persistence, duplicate review and undo on a simulator with a plain-text UIKit sender. Physical iPhone and third-party sender checks remain open.
